name: Ulanhot

routes.outcome: Official Xing'an League organization page identifies the Xing'an League Natural Resources Bureau and Xing'an League Real Estate Registration Center, both based in Ulanhot; the registration center maintains the league registration information platform. Local/regional custodian evidence only, not parcel geometry.
Page retrieved and inspected. It names the local custodian and responsibilities; no public parcel-vector route or safe parcel fields were exposed.
Official Ulanhot-2000 coordinate-system notice confirms the city/central-area survey coordinate system and responsible natural-resources technical unit. It is CRS context, not a parcel service.
Page retrieved. It declares Gauss-Kruger projection, central meridian 122°26′, elevation 245 m, and the geographic extent for the Ulanhot-2000 system; no parcel response was present.

Official report says Ulanhot was a pilot area for the league real-estate registration workflow and data sharing. It references a registration system but does not publish an anonymous parcel API or geometry.
Page retrieved and inspected; no safe parcel identity, schema, or geometry.

Anonymous HTTPS request timed out after 8 seconds. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or retry through a private route was attempted; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
TLS handshake failed for the guessed Ulanhot municipal host. No certificate exception was authorized or used; this is not evidence of missing local coverage.

schemaAndCrs.apiBase: Not identified; no anonymous viewer response or current JavaScript/configuration was obtained.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel response. Official notice documents Ulanhot-2000 as a Gauss-Kruger local projected system with central meridian 122°26′ and elevation 245 m; exact EPSG/native parcel encoding was not exposed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No safe native parcel identity returned. No synthetic identity created and no GeoJSON sample retained.

sourceFieldMapping.crs: Ulanhot-2000 notice only; parcel response CRS not obtained

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: two first-party discovery queries, three official Xing'an League page GETs, one official coordinate-system page inspection, one public registration-viewer GET, and one municipal-host GET

localCustodianAssessment: The official Xing'an League page is direct evidence of the regional natural-resources and real-estate-registration custodians serving Ulanhot. The registration viewer hostname is a broader Inner Mongolia public service route, but it timed out and was not treated as a Ulanhot parcel release.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if independently returned by a public route

qualification.reason: A local/regional registration custodian and coordinate-system evidence are available, but no anonymous parcel schema, stable identity, parcel CRS response, or geometry was obtained. Adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a parcel hit.
Viewer timeout and municipal TLS failure are access limits, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No full parcel polygon is retained and no sample GeoJSON is created.
Official pages establish custodian, workflow, and CRS context but not public parcel coverage, licensing, schema, or geometry.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Raw page/request evidence remains under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/8673/.
uncertainty: The first-party evidence supports a real Ulanhot-serving registration custodian and a declared local coordinate system. Anonymous parcel coverage, public API routes, update cadence, licensing, stable parcel identity, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified.
